exposure: retention of copper 380 mm2 IUD during pregnancy
removal of copper 380 mm2 IUD during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 233 patients with pregnancies conceived with a copper 380 mm2 IUD in situ identified from electronic health records between 2011 and 2021.
finding: Removal of a copper 380 mm2 IUD in pregnant patients significantly improves pregnancy outcomes by reducing the risk of both early pregnancy loss and later adverse outcomes compared to IUD retention.
